settings.title: Settings
settings.providerHintOpenAI: Best default path for chat + Whisper STT. Requires a valid API key.
settings.providerHintOllama: Great for local chat models. API key is optional, but Whisper STT is currently unavailable on this path.
settings.providerHintCustom: Use this for OpenAI-compatible gateways. Chat should work, while speech features depend on your provider.
settings.profileHint: Profiles save provider, endpoint, model, and a separate OS Keychain entry for the API key.
settings.profileNameDuplicate: A profile with this name already exists.
settings.profileCreateKeyRequired: Enter an API key before saving a new OpenAI profile. Existing keys are not copied between profiles.
settings.profileSwitchUnsaved: Switch profiles and discard unsaved settings?
settings.profileDeleteConfirm: Delete config profile "{name}"? Its saved API key entry will also be removed.
settings.apiBaseUrlInvalid: API Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
settings.apiKeyHint: Your API key is stored securely in the OS Keychain
settings.apiKeyOptionalHint: Optional for Ollama and compatible local gateways. Leave empty if your endpoint does not require authentication.
settings.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep current key
settings.apiKeyClearConfirm: Clear the saved API key for the active profile? The profile itself and local data will stay.
settings.sttUnavailableOllama: Voice input is disabled for Ollama because the current integration only verifies chat-compatible endpoints, not Whisper transcription.
settings.ttsVoiceHint: Applies to all AI speech synthesis. Requires internet connection.
settings.ttsPreviewTextEn: This is a quick voice preview for VoxVerse.
settings.ttsPreviewTextZh: 这是 VoxVerse 的语音试听。
settings.diagnosticsHint: Run a lightweight check for chat, microphone transcription readiness, and Edge TTS availability.
settings.diagnosticsPrivacyHint: Copied diagnostics include profile, base URL, model, and API-key saved status only. They never include the API key value.
settings.saveBeforeDiagnostics: Save the current settings before running diagnostics.
settings.diagnosticsEmpty: No diagnostics yet. Save your settings, then run a check here.
settings.autoFeedback: Run automatic correction after each sent message
settings.autoFeedbackHint: When disabled, VoxVerse will only send text for correction, translation, polish, or reports when you trigger those actions manually.
settings.localDataHint: Conversations, characters, memory facts, vocabulary, corrections, and stats stay in the local SQLite database.
settings.keyringDataHint: API keys are stored per profile in the OS Keychain and are never included in diagnostics or exports.
settings.exportDataHint: Use session export or the native CLI when you need a local transcript or learning-data backup.
settings.themeSystemHint: Uses Warm Paper on light systems and Graphite Minimal on dark systems.

graphiteMinimal.name: Graphite Minimal
graphiteMinimal.description: Neutral, compact, and work-focused. This is the default main VoxVerse skin.

warmPaper.name: Warm Paper
warmPaper.description: Ivory paper, warm gray, and terracotta tones for low-stress chat reading.

auroraGlass.name: Aurora Glass
auroraGlass.description: Soft dark glass with controlled aurora color for AI status and feedback moments.

codeConsole.name: Code Console
codeConsole.description: Graphite console surfaces with cyan and green status accents for tools and diagnostics.

darkSignal.name: Dark Signal
darkSignal.description: High-contrast black UI with cool timeline-style signal accents.

liquidFrost.name: Liquid Frost
liquidFrost.description: Light frosted surfaces, soft shadows, and relaxed radius for modal-heavy workflows.

enterpriseCarbon.name: Enterprise Carbon
enterpriseCarbon.description: Dense data-system styling with Carbon-like grays and IBM blue.

primerDev.name: Primer Dev
primerDev.description: GitHub-inspired dark surfaces, badges, and developer-tool contrast.

creativeSpectrum.name: Creative Spectrum
creativeSpectrum.description: Professional creative-tool neutrals with blue and orange control accents.

luxuryConsole.name: Luxury Console
luxuryConsole.description: Black, deep green, and restrained champagne-gold accents for showcase views.
